For an automotive company in Zeebrugge, we are looking for a full-time category B Driver for the 'YARD' department. You will work in a two-shift system.

What does the job entail?

As a Yard Driver / operator, you and your colleagues ensure that port terminal logistics run smoothly and without interruptions.

Main responsibilities:

• Shunting: Safely and efficiently maneuvering and moving vehicles from point A to point B across the yard / terminal grounds.
• Pre-Delivery Inspection (PDI): Carrying out final quality checks before vehicles are dispatched to clients.
• Damage inspection: Checking incoming vehicles at the terminal for any existing damage.
• Periodic maintenance checks: Performing checks such as battery health checks and engine runs.

VG 458/BUOSAP

• driver's license: You have held a valid Category B driver's license for at least 2 years.
• language skills: Very good command (speaking and understanding) of either Dutch or English.
• work ethic: Reliable, punctual, and committed to working with precision and care.
• availability: Available full-time to work in a 2-shift rotation (06:30 - 14:15 / 14:30 - 22:15).
As a yard driver / Operator, you and your colleagues ensure that port terminal logistics run smoothly and without interruptions.

Your future job

As a production operator, you’ll provide support to the press operator during the production process. You’ll make sure that the glue goes into the correct glue tank and closely monitor the glue levels. In addition, you’ll welcome drivers and direct them to the right location.

You’ll also be responsible for maintenance tasks and cleaning the equipment, ensuring everything runs safely and smoothly.

In short: a varied role where you play an important part in keeping the production process efficient and well-organized!

To support our continued growth, we are expanding our presence in Italy and are looking for a driven 
Sales Manager Italy to accelerate our commercial success in this key market.
 

As Sales Manager Italy, you grow our customer portfolio through active prospecting and lasting partnerships. You combine commercial drive with technical understanding to advise customers. You report directly to the Sales Director.

 

•  

A professional sales experience of minimum 5 years
  

•  

Experience in B2B sales, business development, field sales or account management, with success in acquiring new customers.

jobs.occupation: Recruitment Consultant I Open to Graduates & Junior Profiles
jobs.description:
As a Recruitment Consultant, you will help companies identify their future talent while supporting candidates throughout their career journeys. It's a dynamic, entrepreneurial and people-focused role where no two days are the same.

Client Details

You will be joining the newest division of a global player in the field of recruitment, which has also won the Top Employer award several times in a row.

Description

• Attend presentations and meetings
• Approach a network of customers and candidates
• Persuade them to work with you on their recruitment needs
• Negotiate terms, brief them and advise them on their recruitment needs
• Manage the entire recruitment cycle, from candidate selection to offer management
• Participate in job fairs and universities
 

• You speak Dutch and/or French fluently and have an excellent level of English
• You are a driven, social and entrepreneurial person
• You can work autonomously while remaining a real team-player
• You are a persuasive and compelling person able to sell yourself and the company
• You are adaptable and can change your style of delivery depending on your audience

As Lead Full Stack Developer, you take a key role in the further development and evolution of a suite of business-critical applications used in real-time operational environments.You remain strongly hands-on in both backend and frontend development, working primarily with .NET and Angular, while also guiding technical choices, improving existing implementations and helping shape upcoming solutions. You challenge current approaches where needed and translate complex technical topics into clear and pragmatic proposals.A major part of the role is technical leadership. You support and coach other developers, promote knowledge sharing and help maintain high standards in code quality, maintainability and software design. You work closely with analysts, architects, testers and other developers within an Agile/Scrum setup.You also keep a close eye on delivery, scope and technical risks. When dependencies, architectural concerns or implementation issues arise, you identify them early and help the team move towards a robust and sustainable solution.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in IT (or equivalent through strong experience)
• Senior professional experience in .NET & Angular
• +15 years of experience in IT
• You're a pragmatic team player
• You work in English and understand Dutch & French
